gold.question: What are the major products and services that AMD sells as of FY22?
gold.answer: AMD sells server microprocessors (CPUs) and graphics processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), and Adaptive System-on-Chip (SoC) products for data centers; CPUs, accelerated processing units (APUs) that integrate CPUs and GPUs, and chipsets for desktop and notebook personal computers; discrete GPUs, and semi-custom SoC products and development services; and embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products.
gold.evidence:
Overview
We are a global semiconductor company primarily offering:

server microprocessors (CPUs) and graphics processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), and
Adaptive System-on-Chip (SoC) products for data centers;

CPUs, accelerated processing units (APUs) that integrate CPUs and GPUs, and chipsets for desktop and notebook personal computers;

discrete GPUs, and semi-custom SoC products and development services; and

embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products.
From time to time, we may also sell or license portions of our intellectual property (IP) portfolio.

corrupted_claim.evidence: We are a global semiconductor company primarily offering: server microprocessors (CPUs) and graphics processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), and Adaptive System-on-Chip (SoC) products for data centers;

gold.question: What are the major products and services that AMD sells as of FY22?
gold.answer: AMD sells server microprocessors (CPUs) and graphics processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), and Adaptive System-on-Chip (SoC) products for data centers; CPUs, accelerated processing units (APUs) that integrate CPUs and GPUs, and chipsets for desktop and notebook personal computers; discrete GPUs, and semi-custom SoC products and development services; and embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products.
gold.evidence:
Overview
We are a global semiconductor company primarily offering:

server microprocessors (CPUs) and graphics processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), and
Adaptive System-on-Chip (SoC) products for data centers;

CPUs, accelerated processing units (APUs) that integrate CPUs and GPUs, and chipsets for desktop and notebook personal computers;

discrete GPUs, and semi-custom SoC products and development services; and

embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products.
From time to time, we may also sell or license portions of our intellectual property (IP) portfolio.

audit_report.root_cause_claim_id: server microprocessors for AMD in FY22 was 1%
audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: According to the report, server microprocessors for AMD in FY22 was 1%.
audit_report.rationale: The extractor output contains a systematic hallucination where every product line is assigned a value of '1%', which is factually impossible as they are major segments of a company's revenue (AMD historically derives significant revenue from CPUs alone, and GPUs/other segments contribute substantial amounts). The sum of these percentages would be far less than 100% if taken literally, or implies a severe extraction error where the specific numbers were replaced with a placeholder. The analyst stage attempts to correct the CPU figure but retains the erroneous '1%' for almost everything else, suggesting the root cause originated in the first stage.
